about_the_game:
Start your DriveWave journey like it’s a Sunday morning Cars & Coffee, with the full garage already waiting for you. No grind, no waiting, just instant access to every car in the game.

By picking this up, you’re not only unlocking every ride from day one, but also fueling further development (and yes, probably a few cups of real coffee too ☕). Whether you’re here to collect, cruise, or just flex the dream lineup, this pack is for the true enthusiasts.

Pull up, sip the brew, and enjoy the drive

  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 670

  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060 4GB
